stem:
Amit tries to hold his breath during a PE warm-up. After a short time he has to breathe again.

Which statement best explains why holding the breath soon becomes difficult?

options.text: The air he breathes in supplies oxygen his body needs, so he cannot go long without a fresh breath.
He needs nitrogen from the air more than anything else, and that is why breath-holding fails.
His body stops all functions the instant he starts holding his breath.
With enough oxygen stored once, a person can survive indefinitely without breathing again.

teacher.key_rationale: Oxygen from air is essential for survival. Holding the breath cuts the fresh supply, so it soon becomes difficult. Nitrogen is not the reason. The body does not stop all functions instantly, and oxygen is not stored once for indefinite survival.
